vulnerability_mitigations.replay_attacks: Mitigated via X-YORVYN-NONCE cache with 300s TTL pruning.
vulnerability_mitigations.timing_attacks: Mitigated via hmac.compare_digest constant-time string equality.
vulnerability_mitigations.path_traversal: Mitigated via strict regex filename matching and directory boundary verification.
vulnerability_mitigations.denial_of_service_payload_bomb: Mitigated via 25MB maximum raw body byte limit.

adversarial_test_cases.name: Replay Attack Defense (Unique Nonce Enforcement)
adversarial_test_cases.remediation: Worker maintains SEEN_NONCES registry with TTL window; rejects identical request replay.

adversarial_test_cases.name: Expired Timestamp Rejection (300s tolerance window)
adversarial_test_cases.remediation: Constant-time timestamp check enforces abs(time.time() - ts) <= 300.

adversarial_test_cases.name: Untrusted API Key Rejection
adversarial_test_cases.remediation: Header X-YORVYN-API-KEY validated against trusted registry.

adversarial_test_cases.name: Path Traversal Exploit Defense (Safe Asset Filename Sanitization)
adversarial_test_cases.remediation: Strict regex pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.glb$ and Path.resolve().startswith(STORAGE_DIR) boundary check.

adversarial_test_cases.name: Oversized Payload Rejection (25MB Maximum Bound)
adversarial_test_cases.remediation: Worker checks len(raw_body) > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES before parsing JSON.

adversarial_test_cases.name: Malformed JSON Parsing Defense
adversarial_test_cases.remediation: Explicit JSON decode validation with HTTP 400 Bad Request exception.

adversarial_test_cases.name: Non-Existent Job Registry Retrieval (404 Isolation)
adversarial_test_cases.remediation: Returns HTTP 404 Not Found without leaking server internals.

adversarial_test_cases.name: Cooperative Job Cancellation Lifecycle
adversarial_test_cases.remediation: Cooperative cancellation updates job registry to 'cancelled' status.
